question: Parent re-renders, but theme stays "dark". Do readers of ThemeContext re-render because of context?
say: The parent re-renders, but the theme stays dark. Do readers re-render because of context?
explanation: Object.is("dark", "dark") is true, so the context value did not change. A new object literal each render would count as changed.
explainSay: No. The same string means no change. A new object every render would be a change, though.
